---
title: "City and highway mileage"
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: true
---

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: true
#| warning: true

library(ggplot2)
```


## Introduction

This dataset contains fuel-economy data (miles per gallon) for 234 car models. Specifically, we use the `mpg` dataset from the **ggplot2** package. We're going to do this analysis using literate programming.

## Data visualisation

The visualization below shows a positive, strong, and linear relationship between the city and highway mileage of these cars. Additionally, mileage is higher for cars with fewer cylinders.

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatterplot

ggplot(mpg, aes(x = hwy, y = cty, color = cyl)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Data extract

```{r}
#| label: tbl-data
#| tbl-cap: "First five records of fuel-economy data"

mpg[1:5, ]

```
